newsitem.title: UK: Queen Elizabeth congratulates rescued sailor.
newsitem.headline: Queen Elizabeth congratulates rescued sailor.

text.p: Queen Elizabeth on Thursday congratulated capsized British sailor Tony Bullimore who was plucked from icy waters off Australia after cowering for five days in his upturned boat. The monarch, like her compatriots, had followed the dramatic battle by Australian defence forces to save Bullimore and she praised his "extraordinary feat of survival." She also thanked and congratulated the Australians for the dramatic rescue.
"At the moment, I feel ecstatic," an ebullient Bullimore told BBC radio hours after he was pulled to safety.
He was speaking from HMAS Adelaide, the Australian frigate that spotted his yacht's upturned hull drifting in icy waters.
Bullimore had sheltered inside the boat since capsizing on Sunday during the Vendee Globe round-the-world yacht race, one of the world's most dangerous sporting events.
The former marine, chirpy after his ordeal, gave the Australians "10 out of 10" for saving his life. "It was an incredible rescue. I think it will probably go down in history."
